rule: New business licenses as the weekly Chicago New Business Licenses list keeps them (tools/licenses_chicago.py build: a new license at a business site, no person-named, home, mailbox, event or one-person licenses, one row per site) plus its buildings check; the business-history check (it drops a handful of renewals a month) is not run here. streetLevel: a site whose unit is not a floor 2+ or a suite 200+.
